verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party GitLab documentation of registrable outbound HTTP webhooks that a programmatic consumer can subscribe to. The only webhook mentions come from third-party partner listings (Make, a docs-as-code tool) and describe those partners' features. The PagerDuty, Slack and Zulip items are notification integrations, which do not qualify as webhooks. The REST API and OpenAPI material covers inbound calls, not event subscriptions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
